 Get a Workout and Experience Scenic Views on a Stand-Up Paddle Board
Stand-up paddle boarding (SUP) is one of the newest and fastest growing water sports in the world! Learn it easily with our knowledgeable instructors and beginner boards. The beginner stand-up paddle boards you can rent from us are stable and enjoyable for all ages.

Paddle boarding provides an excellent workout and challenges your balance.

No skills are necessary to have fun, even if it’s your first time out.

After basic paddling instruction and tips on standing up, you’re ready to go flat-water cruising on your own.

If you want to rent a paddleboard for a full day or longer, we can drop it off so it’s waiting for you when you arrive in Door County.

The lake warms up very quickly in Door County, making it a fun spot to learn to paddle board.
